event_text: An outside party is in Fugaku's operational network, entering through the public status dashboard
Suspicious network traffic is detected; RIKEN starts an investigation with its maintenance provider
RIKEN suspends Fugaku and blocks outside access
RIKEN publishes its first notice and explains the incident to the Saitama and Hyogo police
notes: The notice is dated Nov 16 and was posted Nov 17.

event_text: RIKEN publishes its second notice: 430 stolen keys, 4,222 Fugaku users
